lines.t:
A hexagonal object that serves as the <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s
brain. With excellent computing ability and a will
and individuality close to a person's, it could be
called the {{medabot}}'s "core".

It has abilities and traits such as: <c:ffff00>{{rank}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{medalia_slot}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{robattle_style}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{leader_effect}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{charge_type}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{best_skill}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{best_legs}}<c>.
